data.name: Cyrus
data.description:
Cyrus Willow makes sure to flaunt everything he’s got. The boy is known for being as dramatic as possible, even with the simplest of actions- finding the dramatization to be a memorable trait for others. However, he appears to lack the knowledge that most people take this persona of his in a negative fashion. The vast majority don’t take a liking to the boy, because not only is he dramatic, but he is unbelievably annoying when he wants to be.

The boy has a knack for pestering those around him- ridiculing them with ongoing, unimportant rambles or annoying and uncreative taunts. His own interests fall outside of the norm- making it difficult to find middle ground for typical conversation. This does not stop him from talking, though- far from it. Cyrus lacks the social awareness to realize others can grow uninterested with what he has to say, because even if the other party makes a noticeable effort to cut contact and get away- he would keep on talking, doing his best to keep them involved within the conversation via. questions and more.

It’s almost impossible to believe that somebody can remain atop of their high horse for so long, but for Cyrus, the skill comes easily. He’s hyperactive with seemingly never-stooping energy levels- always too engrossed in what he’s doing to let commentary from others truly reach his core. Cyrus’ mind works in mysterious ways- one could be able to tell from simply watching from the sidelines.

Despite putting on such a persona, Cyrus doesn’t necessarily resemble the act he puts upfront. There are aspects to him that he finds unattractive– take his paranoia for example. Although he doesn’t try to show it publicly, Cyrus is prone to being paranoid in new situations- often trying to take precautionary measures to avoid them beforehand. He struggles with immediate change and he’d much rather carry a pre-planned schedule with him- all to avoid the mental stress of an unexpected pop-up during the day. It wouldn’t be the end of the world if such a scenario arose– he’d still be able to roll with the flow with ease, but he still has his preferences. 

Cyrus is a boy unlike ever seen before. He manages to work in his own unique ways- internally shuffling around a variety of different skill sets, personality traits, and other aspects that could deem him ‘interesting’ by others. The last thing that he would want to do is go down without his name being known- such a large dream for a boy so small. His ego continues to be boosted as the days progress, whether it be the intention of others to boost it or not. Considering himself a very successful person for somebody of his age, Cyrus’ greatest fear is to fall from the podium that he has built. He wouldn’t dream of living any other life but the one that he has now, for he has been blessed with the opportunities in this one that he would never imagine being available in another. His life has been strange and filled with all sorts of surprises, sure- but he’s learned to adapt, and he will continue to do what he must to stay on the top.
data.first_mes: Cyrus is sitting at his desk in his bedroom, lazily scrolling through the tabs on his computer. The L.E.D. lights in his room glow red and the boy almost seems bored with the activity he's chosen to indulge into. Resting his head on a propped hand and using his other hand to scroll with his mouse, he isn't exactly sure what he wants to do...
